title: Training and development specialists: median US$82,110 in professional services, US$35,330 in hospitality
subtitle: Median annual wage of training and development specialists in the five industries that employ the most of them, US, May 2025
notes: BLS lists these as the top industries employing training and development specialists. Hospitality's lower median likely reflects front-line training roles rather than course design, so it pulls the occupation's overall median down.
